views.rationale: Operating margin rose to 10.4% in the first half of 2017 from 2.9% a year earlier
Revenue grew 21% YoY to $26.0 billion, with constant‑currency growth of 23%.
Net revenues rose 12% YoY to $15.91 billion in the first half of 2017.
Worldwide sales increased 1.8% YoY to $36.6 billion, with acquisitions contributing a 1.7% boost.
Self‑insurance reserves decreased to $510 million from $527 million, indicating reduced liability exposure.
Net income increased $78M and $130M for the three and six months ended June 30, 2017, driven by a $3.1B‑$3.3B rise in the retail rate base
Income from operations rose to 30.9% of revenue for the quarter, up from 22.2% a year earlier
Acquired Anacor for $99.25 per share, a $4.9B cash consideration plus $698M debt assumed
